title: The Rift Descends
next_chapter_hook: The guardian of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion tells Chen Ji: The Xuanwu Sect is merely a chess piece; the true chess player has already revealed themselves

text.content: The Sect Master's body completely shattered under the backlash of forbidden arts, flesh dissolving into scattered powder across the sky. Yet within that chaos, a vertical pupil slowly opened—that pupil glowed with a dark gold that belonged to no human, its depths swirling with visions of ancient stars being destroyed and reborn. Chen Ji felt excruciating pain in his chest; the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms trembled violently, as if in fear, or perhaps in call. "That is not the Sect Master." Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul escaped from the fragment, his voice trembling for the first time, "That is the... guardian of the first level of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion's seal."

The dark gold vertical pupil swept across the battlefield; every disciple touched by its gaze died with blood flowing from all seven orifices, not even having time to scream. Chen Ji pressed down hard on the Tianji Record in his arms, feeling that ancient pressure—more primitive than the Eye of Heavenly Mandate, more... hungry than any existence he had ever known. "Little one, the thing on your body," the vertical pupil finally locked onto Chen Ji, its voice like the first thunderclap at the dawn of creation, "is a fragment we left behind before our slumber."

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji, don't move!" Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shouted sharply, "It's merely a projection; its true body is still sleeping! But it can sense the aura of the Tianji Record—" Before the words finished, that dark gold vertical pupil had pierced through the void, gazing directly at the fragment in Chen Ji's arms. An irresistible suction force arrived, and Chen Ji felt the connection between himself and the Tianji Record being forcibly severed.

text.content: Severe pain spread from the Brow Center to every limb; the Tianji Record emitted dazzling cyan light as it was forcibly peeled away. Chen Ji gritted his teeth, both hands pressing tightly against his chest, blood seeping between his fingers and staining his garments. He felt the memories sealed within the fragment surge forth like a tide—a deliberately erased image: Chen Nian's young face appearing alongside a dark gold vertical pupil in some magnificent palace hall. "Sister..." Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply, a taut string in his heart shattering with a thunderous crack.

dialogue.content: "Tell me," Chen Ji abruptly raised his head, voice hoarse yet carrying an unprecedented sharpness, "what did you do to Chen Nian?" The dark gold vertical pupil seemed momentarily stunned, then emitted a low laughter: "So it's her older brother... Interesting, a blood relative of the Heavenly Fate Key actually delivers themselves to our door." Chen Ji's fingertips deeply embedded into his palms, blood dripping between his fingers. Recorded. This debt, he recorded it.

text.content: At this moment, space in the center of the battlefield violently tore apart. A rift stretching across the heavens opened like a giant beast's mouth; within its depths lay eternal darkness and silent screams. The outline of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion ruins appeared faintly on the other side, and within that outline, countless dark gold lights flickered to life—those were the eyes of the Sleeper, awakening. Chen Ji's Tianji Record trembled violently in his arms; a piece of information he had never seen before forcefully poured into his mind: "The Xuanwu Sect's invasion of the Tianqing Sect three years ago... was no coincidence."

dialogue.content: "Three years ago," Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke with difficulty, "the current Sect Master of the Xuanwu Sect once entered the depths of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion ruins. He came into contact with something he shouldn't have... and after returning, his personality changed dramatically; within five years, he launched three consecutive sect wars. Chen Ji, the Xuanwu Sect is not the main character of this chess game—they are merely chosen chess pieces." Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. He had schemed for three years, believing he had anticipated every detail, only to discover he was merely a chess piece on a much larger board.

text.content: Heavy footsteps came from within the rift. A towering figure walked out from the darkness, its entire body covered in dark gold carapace, its face hidden beneath a helmet, only a pair of eyes burning with the same eerie light as the previous vertical pupil. "Third level guardian of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, commanded to guide the fragment's return." Its voice was devoid of emotion, "Bearer, you have two choices—hand over the fragment, or..." It paused, its gaze sweeping toward the depths of the rift, "be taken back along with your sister."

dialogue.content: A weak yet familiar voice suddenly came from the depths of the rift: "Brother... brother, don't listen to it." Chen Ji's entire body froze. That was Chen Nian's voice, the name he had searched for three years, the name he called out in dreams every night. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul shouted sternly: "Don't fall for it! That's an illusion! It's testing your—" But Chen Ji's reason had already completely collapsed the moment he heard that voice. Three years of restraint, three years of scheming—all of it lost its meaning at this moment.

choice.prompt: Chen Nian's voice comes from the depths of the rift; Chen Ji's composure from years of scheming is on the brink of collapse. He must make a choice—

choices.text: Charge into the rift at any cost
choices.description: Regardless of traps, he must personally confirm Chen Nian's safety. Even risking his life, even losing Heavenly Fate, he must face the truth directly.
choices.visible_cost: Lose a large amount of Heavenly Fate, may trigger fatal backlash
choices.visible_reward: Obtain definite information about Chen Nian, personally confirm her condition
choices.risk_hint: The other side of the rift is full of dangers; Heavenly Fate consumption may lead to instant death

text.content: Chen Ji abruptly stepped forward, his true qi burning to its boiling point. He charged toward the rift regardless, allowing that suction force to engulf him. The Tianji Record Fragment in his arms issued a mournful cry; his life force was visibly draining away. Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul let out a sharp howl: "Chen Ji! Your Heavenly Fate—" But Chen Ji could no longer hear; his eyes held only that rift, and within its depths, that familiar figure.

choices.text: Use the Tianji Record to preview the situation within the rift
choices.description: Employ the Tianji Record's foresight ability, consume 5 points of Heavenly Fate, scout the true situation within the rift before making a decision.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete intelligence on the rift's interior, see through the illusion trap
choices.risk_hint: Each premonition accelerates the fatal backlash, and there is a risk of being interrupted by the guardian

text.content: Chen Ji forcibly suppressed the turmoil in his heart, his fingertip pressing against the Tianji Record Fragment. Pale cyan light spilled from between his fingers; images of the next three hours flickered like a revolving lantern—on the other side of the rift indeed stood a majestic palace, and deep within that palace, a young girl's figure was indeed imprisoned. Her wrists bound by dark gold chains, eyes full of tears and despair. "Nian'er..." Chen Ji's voice was hoarse, yet cold fire rekindled in his pupils. The illusion was real, but Chen Nian was also real.

choices.text: Negotiate with the guardian to buy time
choices.description: Use the fragment as a bargaining chip to negotiate with the guardian, secretly lay out a method to break the situation. Preserve strength, seek a safer rescue path.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain more intelligence about the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion and Chen Nian, seek ally support
choices.risk_hint: The guardian may lose patience and act directly

text.content: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcibly pressing the surging emotions back into his heart. He raised his head, a perfectly timed expression of panic and greed mingled across his face. "What the senior calls 'guiding the return,'" his voice trembled slightly, his acting worthy of a movie emperor, "the junior naturally wishes to cooperate. However, this fragment is tied to the junior's life—may I ask what compensation the senior can offer?" The dark gold armored guardian seemed momentarily stunned, seemingly not expecting a chess piece to actually bargain.

The guardian was silent for a moment, its dark gold eyes scanning Chen Ji repeatedly. "Interesting." It finally spoke, a hint of amusement entering its voice, "Maintaining composure under our pressure, even attempting to negotiate... No wonder the Heavenly Fate Key thinks of you constantly." Chen Ji's heart sank. Thinks of constantly? What does that mean? The guardian continued: "Since you wish to know the truth, I shall tell you—your sister is the key to opening the ninth level seal of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion. Without her, we cannot enter; but without us, she can never exit."

Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul whispered near Chen Ji's ear: "Ninth level... That's where the original Tianji Record was stored. If what they say is true, Chen Nian has been imprisoned all this time, not because she's important, but because she's the only one who can open that door." Chen Ji's fingertips trembled slightly. For three years he had always believed Chen Nian was being held as a hostage, a bargaining chip to threaten him. But now he understood—she is not a chess piece; she is a key, a key deliberately cultivated and deliberately protected. And himself, perhaps from the very beginning, was part of this game.

dialogue.content: "So you allowed the Xuanwu Sect to invade the Tianqing Sect," Chen Ji spoke slowly, his voice unexpectedly calm, "to let me obtain the Tianji Record Fragment?" The guardian did not answer, but that silence itself was the answer. Chen Ji suddenly laughed, the laughter carrying an indescribable bitterness and self-mockery. "Excellent scheming." He said, "Even my belief that I was scheming was part of your plan. Then I want to know—" He raised his head, a sharp glint flashing in his eyes, "What exactly is the thing you truly want?"

text.content: The guardian made an inviting gesture toward the depths of the rift. "The true chess player awaits in the front hall. He will answer your questions." Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill. Chess player—this word Mo Xiansheng had also used, but the "chess player" in the guardian's words was obviously someone else. He looked back at the battlefield behind him; the Tianqing Sect disciples were nearly all dead or wounded, Su Qingyao's figure was nowhere to be seen, and in the distant sky, three streaks of light were rapidly approaching—those were reinforcements from the Xuanwu Sect.

choice.prompt: The guardian issues an invitation; Xuanwu Sect reinforcements are about to arrive. Chen Ji must make a decision—

choices.text: Enter the rift to meet the chess player
choices.description: Since the other party has already laid an elaborate trap, might as well proactively walk into the tiger's den to obtain the most core intelligence.
choices.visible_cost: Go deep into enemy territory alone
choices.visible_reward: Uncover the complete truth of the Heavenly Secrets Pavilion, reunite with Chen Nian
choices.risk_hint: May fall into an absolutely inescapable trap

text.content: Chen Ji did not hesitate. He walked toward the rift, allowing that dark force to engulf him. In the instant before stepping into the darkness, he glanced back—smoke from the battlefield had not yet dispersed, and the Tianqing Sect he had spent three years building had already been completely transformed. "Han Lie..." he murmured that name, a cold glint flashing in his eyes, "You came at just the right time. When I emerge from here, we'll settle accounts properly." As his words fell, darkness completely engulfed him.

choices.text: First deal with the Xuanwu Sect reinforcements
choices.description: Since the Xuanwu Sect is also a chess piece, let's first eliminate this piece while taking the opportunity to probe the enemy's bottom line.
choices.visible_cost: May miss the opportunity to meet the chess player
choices.visible_reward: Defeat Xuanwu Sect genius Han Lie, plunder substantial resources
choices.risk_hint: The chess player may lose patience and harm Chen Nian directly

text.content: Chen Ji turned to face the sky, a cold smile curling at his lips. "Han Lie, you came at just the right moment." His voice was not loud, yet it clearly reached every person present. The three streaks of light halted mid-air; the leading young man wore Xuanwu Sect battle armor, his face cold and stern—it was Han Lie. He looked down at the blood-soaked Chen Ji, disbelief flickering in his eyes: "You're... still alive?" Chen Ji slowly wiped the blood from the corner of his mouth, smiling nonchalantly: "Why, disappointed?"

choices.text: Contact Ye Qing to borrow the Demonic Path mist
choices.description: Utilize the secret techniques of the Demonic Path Saint Ye Qing to conceal aura, silently infiltrate the rift for reconnaissance.
choices.visible_reward: Stealthily infiltrate, obtain first-hand intelligence without exposing intentions
choices.risk_hint: Need time to contact Ye Qing, may miss the opportunity

text.content: Chen Ji secretly crushed an unremarkable jade talisman in his arms. A moment later, a spiritual sense only he could perceive transmitted: "Rift coordinates received. But I must warn you, there are at least three existences no weaker than the Nascent Soul stage within." Ye Qing's voice was cold as always, "The Demonic Path mist can conceal your aura for one hour; consequences of exceeding the time limit are your own responsibility. Additionally—the favor you owe me just increased by another entry." Chen Ji's mouth slightly curved upward. Another favor increased—eventually, he would make Ye Qing willingly cancel that debt.

At this moment, an aged yet authoritative voice came from the depths of the rift: "Since you've come, why hesitate at the doorstep?" Chen Ji's pupils constricted sharply. That voice... he recognized it. Three years ago at the Tianqing Sect Tournament, this voice had announced him as a servant disciple; five years ago when he had just entered the sect, this voice had granted him a status allowing him to barely cultivate. "Ling Yuan..." Chen Ji murmured, his fists tightening. The old Sect Master—the old monster he had always believed was already deceased,竟然还活着，而且——就藏在这裂隙深处。

The guardian bowed toward the depths of the rift: "The chess player invites you." Chen Ji took a deep breath. Whether ahead lay dragon's pool or tiger's den, he had to walk this path. Not for the so-called truth, but for Chen Nian—his sister, imprisoned for three years. He took one last look at the battlefield behind him; there lay the fruits of his three years of scheming, and buried within were all his disguises as a "waste." From the moment he stepped into the rift, he was no longer the forbearing servant disciple.

dialogue.content: Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul suddenly condensed into form; an unprecedented solemnity appeared on that aged face. "Chen Ji, before you step through that door, your master asks you one last time—are you certain you wish to do this?" Chen Ji did not answer, only stepping forward. Mo Xiansheng was silent for a moment, then suddenly sighed deeply: "So be it, so be it. Such is Heavenly Fate... Remember, whatever you see, do not believe your eyes. The true reality does not lie before your eyes, but—" He looked at Chen Ji's Brow Center, "Here." As his words fell, the remnant soul dissipated, leaving only the Tianji Record Fragment in his arms emitting a faint glow.

text.content: The rift contracted the instant Chen Ji stepped in; a majestic force dragged him into endless darkness. After an unknown time, his feet found solid ground; he opened his eyes—a majestic palace stood before him, entirely constructed of dark gold metal, and above the palace gate hung a plaque bearing two ancient characters: Heavenly Secrets Pavilion. The palace gates slowly opened; a familiar figure sat at the main seat within the hall, white-haired and benevolent-faced—it was precisely the old Sect Master of the Tianqing Sect, Ling Yuan. Beside him stood a figure that made Chen Ji's heart stop—Chen Nian, gazing at him with a pair of hollow eyes.

Chen Ji's reason nearly collapsed upon seeing Chen Nian. Everything he had endured and schemed for three years was for this girl. Yet here she stood now, like a wooden puppet without a soul. "Nian'er!" he blurted, voice hoarse. Chen Nian showed no reaction, as if she didn't recognize him at all. Ling Yuan gently sighed: "Three years, and you've finally come."
